payload.title: Bulk promotion threshold off by one (> instead of >=)
payload.markdown:
# Postmortem: Bulk promotion threshold off by one (> instead of >=)

## Summary
Orders of exactly 10 units did not receive the advertised 10% bulk discount.

## Impact
Customers buying exactly the threshold quantity were overcharged by 10% of that line.

## Root cause
promotions.bulkDiscount compared `quantity > BULK_THRESHOLD` while the promotion and its doc comment say '10 or more'.

## Evidence
- Pricing logs: PEN-01 x10 bulk_savings=0.00 vs x12 bulk_savings=3.00
- Reproduction test failed: bulkSavings 0 !== 250

## Fix
Use an inclusive comparison (>=).

## How it was verified
Boundary tests at 9 and 10 units pass along with the existing suite.

- Reproduction test `tests/fixsi/bulk-threshold.test.js` failed before the fix and passes after it.
- Full suite: 32 passed, 0 failed (baseline: 30 passed). Pre-existing tests were not modified.
- Fix attempts: 1.

## Prevention
- Test promotions at threshold-1, threshold and threshold+1
- Express thresholds as 'minQuantity' to make inclusivity explicit

---
